title: Connections
text:
Breadcrumbs
The
Connections
tab lets you set up integrations with various external resources, expanding Leapwork's capabilities for automation, user management, and cloud-based testing.
These connections allow Leapwork to support powerful extensions, such as mobile automation (locally or in the cloud), integration with enterprise systems, and centralized user authentication.
Multiple connections can be created and saved, which can then be applied to each Leapwork instance.
Leapwork supports various ways to set up a connection:
Appium Server
: To support automation of native mobile devices (iOS and Android) hosted locally.
HeadSpin Server
: To support building and running automation using HeadSpin's cloud device farm.
SauceLabs Server
: To enable automation of iOS and Android devices in SauceLabs' cloud environment.
BrowserStack Server
: For automating testing on real devices, emulators, and simulators hosted in BrowserStack's cloud environment.
LambdaTest Server
: To enable automation of native mobile applications on real iOS and Android devices hosted in LambdaTest’s cloud environment.
Azure Active Directory (AAD)
:
To allow administrators to create, manage, and synchronize user accounts across multiple applications and services.
Lightweight Directory (LDAP)
: To provide fast and secure access to centralized user information.
Microsoft Graph (SharePoint)
: To connect with SharePoint for accessing hosted Excel files and documentation blocks.
Single Sign-On (SSO)
: To streamline user authentication across integrated systems.
Azure DevOps (ADO)
: To integrate with ADO test plans, enabling the automation of test cases and synchronization of results.
Note
:
Connections settings would be available if you are logged in as an administrator.
